📦 **ArtGallery `0e5050b`** — art: exhibit twelve workers and garrison residents

Six women and six men, each with occupation-specific props, cyan hair and magenta clothing generated directly. Preserve identical game/gallery originals, character settings, style provenance and all actual prompts. Twelve Portraits cards and twelve original images; gallery build/check, search, category filter and full-image preview pass.

Refs TASK-0901

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
